title: Gritty Strength Minimalist S&C
author: Steven  M.
desc: Gritty Strength Minimalist S&C is a 6-week program designed for intermediate lifters. Train 4 days a week with focused sessions that maximize muscle growth using a full gym setup. Each 20-30 minute workout features compound and accessory movements, ensuring a balanced approach to strength training. Expect to build functional strength and improve your overall performance with targeted exercises.
